name: prompt-360
image_purpose: fashion campaign key visual and editorial portrait

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-cinematic fashion portrait of an adult woman with a massive brown bear as a safely controlled trained companion.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features wears a sleek dark suit blazer, dark tailored trousers, and combat boots. She stands confidently with one hand resting gently on the bear's shoulder while the calm, healthy bear stands slightly behind as a protector and loyal trained companion.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body centered composition, woman in the foreground and massive brown bear behind, solid deep-red studio background, minimal environmental immersion, clear scale and protective relationship.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic directed studio lighting with controlled highlights on suit, boots, and fur, cinematic red atmosphere, bold high-tension editorial mood without danger or harm.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-detailed photorealistic fashion photography, natural human and animal anatomy, realistic fur and tailoring, sharp full-body focus, clean red backdrop, no logos or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-cinematic photorealistic fashion portrait of an adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features in a sleek dark suit blazer, tailored trousers, and combat boots, standing confidently with one hand resting gently on a calm massive brown bear's shoulder. The bear is a safe, trained companion positioned slightly behind her as a protector. Full-body centered composition, deep-red solid studio background, dramatic directed lighting, realistic fur and tailoring, bold strong cinematic editorial mood, minimal environmental immersion.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, animal harm, blood, gore, attack, aggression, distorted animal anatomy, blurry, low quality, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, signature
